title: Frequent power cuts hit Langate market, traders stage protest

ai.summary: Traders in Langate staged a peaceful protest against frequent unscheduled power cuts, accusing the Power Development Department of failing to ensure regular electricity supply.

facts.claim: Traders in Langate staged a peaceful protest
facts.quote: Traders in Langate on Monday staged a peaceful protest against frequent and unscheduled power cuts, accusing the Power Development Department (PDD) of failing to ensure regular electricity supply to the area.
